job.purpose: Settled-market lists (ticker, close_time, result, volume, last price; no candles) of daily, weekly and hourly ladder series not in the research archive, 2026-09-07 to 2026-11-15, for the all-of-Kalshi calibration-map census (counts of settled markets per family and date).
job.heldout: A census of counts only. The landed run carries results of windows other cards may hold out: it goes into HELDOUT_PULL_RUNS.md like every pull run; a reader opens it only through heldout_guard_v2, takes the fields above, and applies its own card's cutoff and the open W3 cuts.
job.notes: 79 requests, page budget 306 plus 14 for 429 retries. Pacing 5.0 s (12 a minute) on EVERY request including each extra page: up to 306 pages is up to about 26 minutes (27 with retries), inside the runner's 40 minute stop. Hourly series are CAPPED SAMPLES (max_pages 3 or 6): the count is a lower bound. Series names are unverified; an unlisted name returns empty.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
